transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Good day, Thomas. I am here to discuss a most unfortunate matter regarding a printing plate I recently commissioned. transcript.speaker: antagonist

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: The order number, Thomas, is ME-1845-029. The plate arrived with a cracked face and smeared type, rendering it entirely unusable. Thank you, sir, ME-1845-029. Let me just consult our records here... Ah, yes, I see the entry for the "Critique of the Gotha Programme" plate.

Regarding the damage you describe, a cracked face and smeared type, that truly is a grave misfortune, especially given the importance of the work. However, I must regrettably inform you, sir, that it is a long-standing shop custom here at Master Henderson's: **all engraving orders are final once the plate has left the workshop; the customer bears full risk of transport damage, without exception.**

Therefore, while I deeply regret the state in which your plate arrived, I am unable to offer either a replacement or a refund for your deposit. The responsibility for the plate's condition during transport unfortunately falls to the customer.
